structs.notes: Replay Online_Commerce is a static singleton (GetInstance returns &s_onlineCommerceInstance, lea only, no allocation), not a heap object; the sized-delete lead is the class's own deleting dtor in its vtable slot 15, so 4424 is the sizeof that the dtor passes. Resolved members are the ones read by Init, GetCurrency, UpdateCurrency, ResetStoreEntitlements, GetCurrencyAmount_0, OnGetCurrencyComplete, RequestCurrencyOnce, SetCurrencyValue, GetCurrencyValue, Online_OnEventResetSlot and the dtors. Misnamed functions found (not renamed, owner or class not proven): Online_Commerce::OnSignedIn@0x1416CFD10 uses s_cgLocalClientStatePtrs and CL_GetScreenDimensions and never touches this (client-side function); Online_Commerce::GetCurrencyAmount_1@0x141B3C2C0 reads s_onlineLootInstance (Online_Loot-shaped), not Online_Commerce; Online_Commerce::GetCurrencyAmount@0x141B3C230 reads a table at a1+120064, which is outside a 4424-byte object, so it is not an Online_Commerce method; Online_Commerce_OnReconcileLicensesSuccess@0x141064E40 takes a request object with Online_Backoff at +72 and calls Online_ExchangeRequest_UpdateRetry on it, so its class is not Online_Commerce; Online_Commerce_AuditLogBuffer_dtor@0x141B32980 destroys the 936-byte response at this+120 (16 bdMarketplaceCurrencyAmount at +16..+912, base at +16, bdReferencable at +920): probably bdGetPlayerBalancesResponse's dtor, UNCONFIRMED (its vtable not checked); DbdMarketplaceAuditLogResult_QEAAXXZ_5 (the element dtor called 20 and 16 times) is a bdMarketplaceCurrencyAmount-sized element dtor, name unproven.
